sources.title: Akamai Form 8-K, November 10, 2026 (convertible senior notes pricing)
Akamai press release, November 9, 2026 (Exhibit 99.1): pricing of convertible senior notes

event.title: Akamai prices two convertible-note series
event.summary: Akamai priced two series of convertible senior notes in a private offering to qualified institutional buyers.

amounts.label: Both series (computed by Tokscale: $1.1B + $1.1B)
amounts.quote: today announced that it has priced its private offering of $1.1 billion in aggregate principal amount of 1.00% convertible senior notes due 2028 (the "2028 Notes") and $1.1 billion in aggregate principal amount of 1.00% convertible senior notes due 2031 (the "2031 Notes" and, together with the 2028 Notes, the "notes").

amounts.label: Convertible Senior Notes due 2028
amounts.quote: On November 9, 2026, Akamai Technologies, Inc. issued a press release announcing that it has priced $1.1 billion of Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 and $1.1 billion of Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 in a private offering to persons reasonably believed to be qualified institutional buyers.

amounts.label: Convertible Senior Notes due 2031
amounts.quote: On November 9, 2026, Akamai Technologies, Inc. issued a press release announcing that it has priced $1.1 billion of Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 and $1.1 billion of Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 in a private offering to persons reasonably believed to be qualified institutional buyers.

facts.label: Expected closing
facts.text: The sale was expected to close on November 12, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
facts.quote: The sale of the notes is expected to close on November 12, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.

facts.label: Use of proceeds
facts.text: To repay part of the convertible notes due 2027 and to fund capital expenditure of the Cloud Infrastructure Services business.
facts.quote: Akamai intends to use the remaining net proceeds from the offering to repay at maturity a portion of Akamai's $1.15 billion outstanding aggregate principal amount of 0.375% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027 (the "2027 Convertible Notes"), which mature on September 1, 2027, and/or to pay cash amounts due upon any earlier conversion of the 2027 Convertible Notes, and to fund the capital expenditure requirements of its Cloud Infrastructure Services (CIS) business
